requirement_coverage.note: State 5: operation-status with blocked lozenge 'Suspended pending succession' and heading 'This fund is suspended pending succession'; no Recommend a grant action is rendered. The sentence is the heading, not the lozenge, because lozenge text does not wrap (see FORMA-GAP-NEW lozenge length).
State 1: work-queue 'Needs your attention' is first in source order with 2 items, each with exactly one named action. Ordering and rule creation are application behaviour.

Separate metric cards for Available to grant ($100,000.00), Market value (informational) and Pending; native disclosure 'How this is calculated' lists the three components with deducted values labelled in text.
State 4 shows 'Not current' (unknown) with as-of time and states that Available to grant is used instead. Computing staleness against the business-day limit is application behaviour.
Held grant item reads 'On hold: charity eligibility' (data-state=blocked) with a text reason.
State 3 empty-state 'No grants yet' with a 'Recommend a grant' action; state 2 skeleton loading with aria-busy.
Paid grant shown as feed-item; no toast used. Sourcing from the notification catalog is application behaviour.
site-footer shows legal sponsor name, EIN and control statement (requires the marketing .forma-site frame; see gap on application footer).
scope-trail shows sponsor, program and fund. Re-authorizing and reloading on scope change is application behaviour.
